meta.warning: Amounts and note assignments in the source file are randomly generated. Structural findings are real; correlations are not.

invoices.status.reason: All 23 rows marked Sent are already past due. Draft is an indefinite parking state. Use true_state instead.

invoices.amount.reason: Near-uniform distribution, no relationship to scope, client or date. Safe to sum; unsafe to correlate.

invoices.issue_date.reason: 25% of invoices were issued on a Saturday or Sunday. A process smell, not a data error.

invoices.line_items.reason: Exactly 10 distinct values. Parseable into service_type and usable as a price-band key.

invoices.notes.reason: 11 fixed strings plus 35 nulls. The only place operational truth is recorded.

estimates.status.reason: Pending has a median age of 319 days, so it is a graveyard rather than a live stage.

clients.industry.reason: Disagrees with the company name on 27 of 30 rows. Never group by this. Use industry_derived and label it inferred.

clients.account_age_months.reason: Impossible for 9 of 30 clients: activity predates the account. Unverifiable above 20 months since history spans only 20 months.

clients.health.reason: 7 casing variants collapsing to 3 states, 7 clients unrated. Unrated clients carry the most money and the lowest past-due rate, so it does not track risk.

clients.primary_contact.reason: 22 names from 8 first names x 7 last names for 30 clients. Likely duplicated or synthetic records.

clients.name.reason: The only trustworthy field in the clients table, and the key that exposes industry.

clients.client_id.reason: Joins all three tables with zero orphans and zero id-to-name mismatches across 283 rows.
